cells.gaps: NITDA says financial accounts without naming bank or mobile money; EFInA's 73% formally included is an inclusion share. No survey found gives the share of adults paying digitally.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 131 (no), stays 4: EFInA's formal-inclusion share no longer counts, but NITDA's November 2026 survey puts adults holding financial accounts at 86.5% (NGA-010), over four in five. No survey gives the share paying digitally at 79% or more, so not 5.
